--- page 2 ---
Performance takes
a new form. And it’s
wicked awesome.
Tired of all the performance cars out there that look so much the same, you
can hardly tell them apart? Then it’s time you took a look at the all-new 2019
Hyundai Veloster.
Reprogrammed with next-gen technology. Retuned to optimize its sure-
footed traction. Re-engineered with turbocharging on three trim levels. And
redesigned to give its signature 3-door concept a modern, boldly sculpted
form. “The new Veloster” notes Motor Trend “certainly won’t be mistaken for
anything else.”1 Not with that underbody rear air diffuser, center exhaust and,
on Turbo Ultimate models, contrasting black roof.
And while it separates itself from the pack of cookie-cutter designs, the new
Veloster is all about connecting you seamlessly to both the road and your
digital world. The tight grip of a new multi-link rear suspension is the next
best thing to Velcro.® Veloster also syncs with connectivity technologies,
voice assistants and custom apps that transform the relationship between
you, your car and your smartphone.
If the new 2019 Veloster sounds like a car you can’t wait to drive, visit your
Hyundai dealer. While you’re at it, check out the free downloadable version
of the new Veloster you can drive via Forza Motorsport 7 on Xbox One®.2
Spotting the new Veloster is easy. It’s the wicked-looking one.
Hyundai has the lowest 5-Year Cost to Own of all brands for 2018 according to
Kelley Blue Book’s KBB.com, highlighting our industry-leading ownership value.3

--- page 4 ---
You don’t just sit in it.
You plug into it.
In creating the new Veloster, designers from Hyundai studios around the world were given a
challenge: Reimagine the driver’s car. Which explains why, when you sit in the driver’s seat of the
2019 Veloster, you sense the interior was designed with you at the center of it all.
Each trim level is designed with unique colors, materials and accents. An asymmetrical dashboard
layout and connectivity technologies like Apple CarPlay,™ Android Auto™ and Bluetooth® cater to
your sense of command and control.1 The seat you’ve settled into is instantly comfortable with the
firm support you’ll need to keep you planted when the road twists and turns. And like a jet pilot,
you can project information such as turn-by-turn navigation onto the available Heads-up Display
transparent pop-up screen in front of you.2
Opening the hidden third door makes it easy for rear-seat passengers to enjoy Veloster almost
as much as you do. And there’s space in back to bring everyone’s gear along. With the rear seats
up, the new Veloster has more cargo room than the Honda Civic Coupe, MINI Cooper 2-door and
4-door, Fiat 500 and VW Beetle.3 When you need to transport larger objects, Veloster’s 60/40 split
rear seats fold down for 44.5 cubic feet of storage – and its hatch opens wide for easy loading.
The Air In There
A standard cabin air filter lets you breathe easy, knowing dust
and pollen are being cleansed from the interior air. Automatic
temperature control and an oversized sunroof let you choose
the perfect climate inside your Veloster’s cockpit.4

It’s time you felt a truly special
connection with your car.
Hyundai’s award-winning Blue Link technology keeps you connected to the services,
information and entertainment you want and need on the road.1 It starts with Blue Link
Connected Care. Complimentary for your first three years, it offers exceptional peace of mind.
Your vehicle can automatically call for help if you’re in an accident and the airbags deploy.
You can also push Blue Link’s SOS button for 24/7 emergency assistance 365 days a year.2
Then there’s Blue Link Guidance. It lets you search, download and navigate to addresses and
points of interest using voice commands from the driver’s seat or your smartphone before
entering your car.3
If you’re like most Hyundai owners, the Blue Link feature you’ll love most is Remote Access.4
Using your MyHyundai app, you can turn your smartphone into a remote control that locks Hyundai Blue Link®
